purpose: Prove the ext_stress synthetic hostcall path drives the real extension hostcall reactor queues before future NUMA or lane-placement decisions use reactor metrics.

harness_changes.synthetic_hostcall: agent_start handler calls pi.events("list_flags", {}), which resolves to a fast-lane hostcall and is submitted through the reactor mesh when enabled. Each synthetic extension is materialized in its own isolated subdirectory (synthetic-hostcall-{idx}/index.js) to satisfy per-extension root ownership isolation.

usage.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/dev/shm/pi_rch_target rch exec -- cargo build --locked --example ext_stress && /dev/shm/pi_rch_target/debug/examples/ext_stress --synthetic-hostcall-extensions 4 --synthetic-hostcall-root /tmp/pi_ext_stress_run2/synthetic --manifest-path tests/ext_conformance/VALIDATED_MANIFEST.json --artifacts-dir tests/ext_conformance/artifacts --event-payloads-path tests/ext_conformance/event_payloads/event_payloads.json --event agent_start --reactor-enabled=true --reactor-shards 4 --reactor-lane-capacity 128 --reactor-drain-budget 128 --duration-secs 2 --warmup-secs 0 --rss-interval-secs 1 --events-per-sec 2 --dispatch-timeout-ms 2000 --require-reactor-activity=true --report-path /tmp/pi_ext_stress_run2/ext-stress-reactor-queue-coverage.json --events-path /tmp/pi_ext_stress_run2/ext-stress-events.jsonl --run-id bd-bridge-9-reactor-proof-20261121 --correlation-id bd-bridge-9-reactor-proof-20261121
notes: Use a synthetic_hostcall_root outside docs/evidence so generated JS extension sources do not become repository artifacts.
The run exits nonzero when --require-reactor-activity=true and either enqueue or dispatch counters remain zero.
The report keeps normal ext_stress RSS, latency, event-count, and comparison fields intact.
